crossRefs.note: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.
Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing…
He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.

people.name: Galilee
people.line: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry

people.name: Judea
people.line: The southern region of Israel, centered around Jerusalem

translations.web: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.
translations.bsb: And He continued to preach in the synagogues of Judea.
translations.kjv: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.
translations.asv: And he was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.
